[.verse-line]
[.i158]##{nbsp}##_N. N._ of B----s County, pray don’t be angry with
[.i1080]##{nbsp}##poor Richard.
[.i157]##{nbsp}##_Each Age of Men new Fashions doth invent;_
[.i275]##{nbsp}##_Things which are old, young Men do not esteem:_
[.i166]##{nbsp}##_What pleas’d our Fathers, doth not us content;_
[.i283]##{nbsp}##_What flourish’d then, we out of fashion deem:_
[.i396]##{nbsp}##_And that’s the reason, as I understand,_
[.i391]##{nbsp}##_Why_ Prodigus _did sell his Father’s Land._
